# Chapter 1 enemies: the tuning table

<!-- Generated by axiomancer-mechanics/src/CLI/chapter1-enemies.cli.ts; do not edit. -->

> measured at b3407272, 2026-11-11, 100 runs per cell, seed 1

Every Breakwater foe at its node's level (`BW_ENCOUNTER_FOES`, `BW_ELITE_DRAWS` and the chapter boss node, so a foe added to any
appears on the next run), against the four lane decks kitted at player levels 8 and 10. A measurement, not a
gate (D57), and not a licence to tune (D88). Cite it with its commit.

## How to read it

A cell reads `turns to kill / VITAE lost (share of the player's max VITAE)`. Turns are the player turns of the
fights the deck won; VITAE lost is the player's max minus the mean VITAE left, a lost fight counting as all of
it. A cell appends `win N%` when the deck did not win every fight. Foe VITAE is the live encounter VITAE
(x2) after the tier and level scaling, shown in the VITAE column.

- The player is an even stat spread at the level, wearing the lane's relics.
- grey: 10 cards, all upgraded once; relics none
- blood-price: 20 cards, all upgraded once; relics Crimson Circlet, Ruby Signet, Bleeding Signet
- elementalist: 20 cards, all upgraded once; relics Elementalist's Signet, Elementalist's Brooch, Elementalist's Belt
- defender: 20 cards, all upgraded once; relics Thornback Signet, Mirror Brooch, Carapace Belt
- Player max VITAE: grey L8 230, L10 242; blood-price L8 250, L10 262; elementalist L8 250, L10 262; defender L8 250, L10 262.
- Each elite node (`bw-c1`, `bw-l4`, `bw-w5`) gets one row per foe it draws, since the node draws one of them with equal odds (a third each at the sea cave, a half at the others).
- A foe staged at two nodes shares one row, its nodes listed.
- The chapter boss (the map's `boss` node) has its own row, marked (boss), staged at the level its node pins.

## Limits

- 100 seeded fights per cell, seeds 1 to 100; rider rolls are seeded by the fight seed, so a rerun reproduces the table.
- The sim never pays the Wreckmaster's toll: "Pay the toll" is a player board action, not a card, so the Wreckmaster rows are the cost of refusing it.
- Mercy is off: no lane here casts The Open Hand.
- Sim drivers are not players: `human-like` is the headline (one best line, no chaining), `witness` plays the whole hand and reads as a ceiling.
